youtube.title: Napoleon sold half of America for 3 cents an acre 🇺🇸 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The Louisiana Purchase: Jefferson only wanted New Orleans… Napoleon sold him half a continent. 🇺🇸

Team Jefferson or Team Napoleon? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1803 the US offered about $10 million for New Orleans. Napoleon, needing money for war with Britain, offered all of Louisiana instead: about 828,000 square miles for $15 million (roughly 3 cents an acre). It doubled the size of the United States, and Napoleon said he had just given England a rival that would one day humble her.
